title: Configure AWS Batch launch template with 100GB EBS root volume for Higgs 4B model

comments.author: home
comments.text:
Higgs Audio v3 (multimodalart/higgs-audio-v3-tts-4b-transformers) requires downloading 9.3GB of safetensors weights at runtime.
The default EC2 AMI root EBS volume (30GB) on g4dn.xlarge has only ~1.7GB free after the ECS AL2023 NVIDIA base AMI, drivers, and pre-baked Docker worker image layers.
To enable Higgs inference on Batch, configure an EC2 Launch Template with a 100GB gp3 EBS root volume (/dev/xvda) on the GpuComputeEnv compute environment in cdk/stacks/backend.py.
